prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1025; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage does not match the story: the dents are on another side and at another height than the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents a side impact to the driver's door and rear quarter panel, with deformation concentrated lower on the body than the claimant's account would suggest, and the dents sit on the opposite flank from the reported point of contact. The proposed repair plan covers panel straightening, replacement of the rear door skin, refinishing of adjacent panels for colour match, and recalibration of the door-mounted sensor. Labor hours requested are consistent with the extent of the visible deformation and the parts listed. Shop invoices show a single set of charges with no repeated line items. Inspection found no indication of prior collision repair or unrelated older damage on the vehicle. The location and height of the dents should be reviewed against the loss description before final approval.
